my.title: Bencana Besar
my.text: Wah, ini memang dah melampau. Macam tak pernah dengar pasal Malaysia pun. Mungkin sejarah bukan untuk kau… atau apa-apa pun sebenarnya.

en.title: Total Disaster
en.text: Wow, this is beyond bad. It’s like you’ve never heard of Malaysia before. Maybe history isn’t your thing… or anything, really.

my.title: Memalukan Negara
my.text: Tidur masa kelas sejarah ke? Jawapan ni terlalu teruk, sampai rasa macam tak sayang negara. Cuba lagi, atau pindah je la.

en.title: National Embarrassment
en.text: Did you sleep through history class? This answer is so bad, it’s practically unpatriotic. Try again, or consider relocating.

my.title: Patriot Setengah Masak
my.text: Kau macam tahu, tapi tak tahu sangat. Macam kibarkan bendera dengan malas—sedih je tengok. Kaji balik sejarah kau, kawan.

en.title: Half-Baked Patriot
en.text: You’re kind of there, but mostly not. It’s like waving a flag with no enthusiasm—just sad. Brush up on your history, champ.

my.title: Rakyat Malaysia Biasa-Biasa
my.text: Kau tahu cukup untuk tak memalukan diri sepenuhnya, tapi jujurnya—kau takkan menang anugerah 'Patriot Sejati' dengan jawapan ni.

en.title: Mediocre Malaysian
en.text: You know just enough to not be completely embarrassing, but let’s be honest—you’re not winning any 'True Patriot' awards with this.

my.title: Hampir Anak Malaysia
my.text: Kau hampir jadi juara, tapi belum cukup lagi. Semangat ada, tapi nampak macam kau baca sinopsis sejarah je. Lain kali, fokus betul-betul!

en.title: Almost Anak Malaysia
en.text: You’re close, but not close enough. You’ve got the spirit, but it seems like you skimmed the textbook. Go all in next time!

my.title: Merdeka Mastermind
my.text: Wah, nampaknya kau ensiklopedia berjalan tentang Malaysia! Macam kau ada kat sana masa 1957 dulu. Jangan terlalu bangga sangat pulak.

en.title: Merdeka Mastermind
en.text: Well, well, well, look who’s a walking encyclopedia of Malaysia! It’s almost like you were there in 1957. Don’t let it go to your head.
